expected_items.description: Move the git clone and workspace selection flow into the desktop app rather than requiring a pre-cloned external folder.
Persist the active workspace profile in app data so shell/editor features use the app-selected workspace.
Source editor file operations and CLI session/task working directories should prefer the app-selected workspace.
Expose workspace host behavior as a desktop runtime panel rather than hiding it behind manual developer setup.
If Git is unavailable, clone should degrade as capability_missing without blocking the whole app.
Manage the change through requirements, specs, tasks, validation, traceability, web-first record, and history files.

artifact_checks.purpose: Runtime desktop workspace host commands and workspace root resolution.
Workspace Host panel and command invocation UI.
Runtime command contract for app-owned workspace host behavior.
Build, readiness, contract, and Browser smoke validation record.
